score_method: Unweighted average of six audit weighted-pass scores; not_applicable rows excluded from each audit denominator.

top_fixes.finding: Homepage lacks Organization and WebSite schema, while brand/corporate naming and the 1989/2006 history are inconsistent.
top_fixes.fix: Confirm the approved entity hierarchy and timeline, then implement one canonical Organization/WebSite graph with verified name, logo, URL, and sameAs profiles.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Clearer entity understanding for search engines and AI answer systems.

top_fixes.finding: Titles exceed the audit length target on key templates and the product DOM contains a duplicate hidden H1.
top_fixes.fix: Rewrite template titles to 30–60 characters and remove the duplicate product-template H1.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Cleaner relevance signals and more predictable search-result presentation.

top_fixes.finding: Search intent, demand, indexation, sitemap submission, and rich-result performance cannot be validated without Keyword Planner/SERP evidence and the exact GSC property.
top_fixes.fix: Connect surabhi-foods.com GSC and restore permitted Keyword Planner/SERP evidence, then rerun the blocked rows.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Replaces crawl-only assumptions with query, indexation, and enhancement evidence.

top_fixes.finding: Visible image-alt coverage is poor on homepage and product templates.
top_fixes.fix: Add accurate alt text to meaningful product, campaign, and content images; preserve empty alt only for decorative assets.

top_fixes.finding: Homepage View All links send users and crawlers to the legacy surabhisauces.com host.
top_fixes.fix: Replace them with same-domain Surabhi Foods recipe and blog URLs and recrawl for residual old-host links.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Stronger internal discovery and less authority leakage.

top_fixes.finding: Field CWV passes, but lab mobile performance is weak: performance 37, lab LCP about 10.8–11.6 seconds, render-blocking opportunity, and image-delivery score 0.
top_fixes.fix: Optimise the hero/LCP asset, responsive image delivery, critical CSS, and noncritical theme/app scripts; retest mobile.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Faster cold-load experience and better resilience of the current field CWV pass.

top_fixes.finding: The sampled article lacks visible author/source evidence, semantic H2 structure, topical internal links, and concise answer blocks.
top_fixes.fix: Add visible attribution, sources, structured comparison sections/table, and relevant product/recipe links.
top_fixes.expected_impact: Stronger usefulness, E-E-A-T signals, crawl paths, and answer-engine extractability.

blockers: Exact surabhi-foods.com Google Search Console property is not connected.
Keyword Planner demand/SERP evidence was unavailable; keyword clusters are seed-backed only.
No controlled manual AI-answer-engine visibility study was run.
Google Rich Results Test/Search Console enhancement validation was unavailable.
evidence_note: Public evidence was gathered with a 40-page Firecrawl crawl, targeted Firecrawl rendered extraction, live Playwright DOM evaluation including a 390px mobile check, PageSpeed/CrUX, and local Lighthouse.
